title: Multiple runs of email retrieval on the same emails don't persist again
summary: Email retrieval no longer creates duplicate entries when the same emails are retrieved multiple times. A new centralized FindRetrievedEmail method helps connectors check if an email was already stored, and attachments are added only when needed.
key_points: The Outlook connector now checks if an email was previously retrieved before persisting it again
A new centralized FindRetrievedEmail method on the Email module consolidates this logic for all connectors
Attachments are added to already-retrieved emails only if they weren't previously stored
A new AddAttachment overload allows adding attachments without triggering validation that prevents modifying received emails
The fix prevents the email message Modify subscriber from blocking legitimate attachment additions
quote: Email is returned without further persisting, unless the previous email was stored without attachments, in which case only the attachment is added.
